name: Artifacts and treasure
description: Colourless, blue and red cards that make Treasure and Clues, mana rocks, constructs that grow with every artifact you have, and ways to spend it all.

cards.name: Pell Brassgrin, Harbour Captain
cards.rule_text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.

cards.name: Iselde, Coil Artificer
cards.rule_text:
Artifact spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
At the beginning of your end step, if you've cast an artifact spell this turn, create a 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "This token gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control."
cards.flavor_text: "Give me a box of scraps and an evening."

cards.name: Coin-Pocket Goblin
cards.rule_text:
Haste
Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token.

cards.name: Wreck-Diver Salvager
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, create a Treasure token.

cards.name: Lamplit Inquirer
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
cards.flavor_text: Every mystery starts with a small light.

cards.name: Archive of Small Secrets
cards.rule_text:
When CARDNAME enters, investigate.
Activated abilities of Clues you control cost {1} less to activate.

cards.name: Coppercoil Dynamo
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add {C}{C}. Spend this mana only to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.

cards.name: Moneylender's Scale
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{2}, {T}: Create a Treasure token.
cards.flavor_text: It always tips a little in the lender's favour.

cards.name: Pickpocket's Gauntlet
Rivet-Stack Construct
cards.rule_text:
Trample
CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each other artifact you control.
cards.flavor_text: Built from whatever was lying about.

cards.name: Clockwork Nursery
cards.rule_text: {2}, {T}: Create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.

cards.name: Slag-Pit Slinger
cards.rule_text: {1}, Sacrifice an artifact: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. Activate only once each turn.

cards.name: Spent Fuse
cards.rule_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may sacrifice an artifact.
CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If you sacrificed an artifact this way, it deals 4 damage instead.

cards.name: Gearlock Denial
cards.rule_text: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {X}, where X is the number of artifacts you control.

cards.name: Sift the Workbench
cards.rule_text: Draw two cards. If you control three or more artifacts, draw three cards instead.

cards.name: Raid the Counting House
cards.rule_text: Create three Treasure tokens. Then draw a card if you control five or more artifacts.

cards.name: Gildspark Wyrm
cards.rule_text:
Flying
When CARDNAME enters, create two Treasure tokens.
Whenever you sacrifice a Treasure, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.

cards.name: Hoardbound Colossus
cards.rule_text:
Affinity for artifacts (This spell costs {1} less to cast for each artifact you control.)
Trample
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a Treasure token.

cards.name: Brine-Rust Wharf
cards.rule_text:
CARDNAME enters tapped.
When CARDNAME enters, create a Treasure token.
{T}: Add {U} or {R}.
cards.flavor_text: Half the cargo sank. The other half is ours.
